reviewScope: Complete CR56 cumulative task-catalog, audio-register, RTL/LTR form directionality, scroll-to-top transition, and 53/53 lesson + A0 gate accessibility audit synchronization

sources.title: W3C Internationalization — Structural markup and right-to-left text in HTML (dir='rtl' and dir='auto' on form controls and textareas)
sources.takeaway: Confirms that in an RTL HTML document (<html lang='ar' dir='rtl'>), setting dir='auto' on form inputs and multi-paragraph <textarea> elements assigns paragraph base direction per first strong character so German LTR sentences and Arabic RTL text align and punctuate accurately.

sources.title: W3C WAI — Understanding WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.4.10: Reflow (Level AA, 320 CSS px)
sources.takeaway: Verifies WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.10 Reflow at 320 CSS pixels width and 256 CSS pixels height, including scrollable data-table region exceptions (.lesson-table-wrap) and single-column responsive reflow without horizontal document overflow.

sources.title: W3C WAI — Understanding WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.4.3: Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA)
sources.takeaway: Verifies WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 minimum luminance contrast ratios (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text) and explains why automated tools report incomplete checks when background gradients or scrollable bordered form controls require manual verification.

sources.title: W3C WAI — Understanding WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 2.1.1: Keyboard (Level A)
sources.takeaway: Verifies WCAG 2.1 SC 2.1.1 keyboard operability across native HTML form controls, buttons, dialogs, and scrollable regions.

sources.title: W3C WAI — Understanding WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 2.4.3: Focus Order (Level A)
sources.takeaway: Verifies WCAG 2.1 SC 2.4.3 sequential focus navigation, modal sidebar focus trapping/inert background, and scroll/focus continuity across view transitions.

sources.title: Lingolia — Passive Voice in German Grammar (Vorgangspassiv, Zustandspassiv, and Passive with Modal Verbs)
sources.takeaway: Confirms German passive with modal verbs (Modalverb + Partizip II + werden) for B2.3 exercise 2 heading synchronization (DL-B2-03-T02).

sources.title: Lingolia — Modal Verbs in German Grammar (müssen, können, möchten)
sources.takeaway: Confirms modal verb conjugation and sentence-final infinitive placement across A1.5, A1.8, and A1.9 audio-register section headings.

sources.title: Lingolia — Separable and Inseparable Verbs in German Grammar (Trennbare Verben)
sources.takeaway: Confirms separable verb syntax and Partizip II formation across A1.4 and A1.6 audio-register section headings.

sources.title: Lingolia — Perfekt (Perfect Tense in German Grammar)
sources.takeaway: Confirms Perfekt auxiliary selection (haben/sein) and Partizip II formation for A1.6 audio-register synchronization.

sources.title: Duden — Partizip (Rechtschreibung, Bedeutung, Grammatik)

sources.title: Duden — Modalverb (Rechtschreibung, Bedeutung, Grammatik)

sources.title: Duden — Passiv (Rechtschreibung, Bedeutung, Grammatik)
